cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get a clear account of both office problems. Before I explain the kitchen, tell me what went into the printer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Labels. But can we go outside? I can smell smoke from the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We can do this in the fresh air. You won't need to write anything down; just tell me whether you chose the labels yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Now tell me what you did in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the next turn. One yes or no first: did you see the warning that those labels weren't for printers? I'll use your exact words.
